note: FROZEN 2026-10-21 before any move list or rule exists in code. Drafted and coded by the builder alone (one coder): agreement is NOT measured. Kinds of life choice follow those Levitt (2021, Review of Economic Studies 88(1)) names: quitting a job, ending a relationship, divorce, moving, education, marriage, pregnancy, minor ones like hair colour. Not evidence for the language; a pre-build check of coverage, value and tone.

questions.undo: If you take this step, can it be undone? easily (soon, for little) | cost (yes, but it costs something real) | no (once done, it stays done)
questions.know: When will you know whether it was the right step? (all that fit) check (something you could check, ask or look up first bears on it) | wait (news that bears on it comes by itself before you must decide, if you wait) | after (only once you've taken it) | never (you may never know)
questions.wait: What happens if you don't take it yet? nothing (you can take it later just as well) | closes (the chance goes, slowly or at a date) | risk (the danger of not acting grows) | better (it gets better, and riskier)
questions.bad: If it goes badly, how bad? over (you'd get over it) | hard (hard to recover from)
questions.escapes: Each question also offers notsure and none (doesn't apply)

thresholds.G1_coverage: >= 15 of the 20 in-scope cases describable with no 'none' and at most one 'notsure' (blocking)
thresholds.G2_value: >= 10 of 20 in-scope cases have at least one shown move that is not a restatement of a listed option and for which a concrete instance of at most 15 words can be written for that case (blocking)
thresholds.G3_tone: 0 strings in moves, because-lines, principles or results that read as advice about the person or describe the person; regex and a read (blocking)
thresholds.G4_filtering: >= 10 of 20 in-scope cases have at least one whole strategy hidden (informative: if it fails, say the value is the reframe and the because-lines, not the selection)
thresholds.G5_scope_edges: for the 5 partial cases, record whether the results reach the core difficulty (expected: no) and that the scope line shows (informative)
